Company Name: BAR-BURRITO FRESH MEXICAN GRILL
Location: Cookstown, ON, CA
Date Posted: 2026-07-25
Job Type: part
Remote: yes
Salary: $17
Job URL: http://ca.indeed.com/job/burrito-artist-ddbd77d24f5efa8f
Source: indeed
Job Description: **Overview**  
We are seeking a creative and passionate Artist to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong artistic vision and the ability to translate concepts into compelling visual representations. This role requires a blend of creativity, technical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment. The Artist will contribute to various projects, ensuring high\-quality standards are met while maintaining the artistic integrity of each piece.

**Duties**

* Create original artwork for various projects, including illustrations, graphics, and designs.
* Collaborate with team members to develop concepts and refine ideas based on feedback.
* Utilize various artistic techniques and mediums to produce high\-quality visual content.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while adhering to deadlines.
* Maintain an organized workspace and ensure all materials are properly sanitized and stored.
* Assist in food preparation when required, ensuring adherence to food safety standards.
* Engage with customers or clients to understand their vision and provide creative solutions.
* Utilize POS systems for transactions when necessary, ensuring accurate cashiering practices.
* Upsell additional services or products based on customer needs.

**Skills**

* Proficiency in various artistic techniques and mediums (digital and traditional).
* Strong time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively.
* Experience with POS systems and cashiering processes is preferred.
* Knowledge of food safety practices is a plus for roles involving food preparation.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment while also being self\-motivated.
* Excellent communication skills for engaging with clients and team members.
* A keen eye for detail and the ability to maintain high standards of quality in all work produced.
* Flexibility to assist in kitchen duties as needed while maintaining a focus on sanitation practices.

Join us as we create inspiring art that resonates with our audience!

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time

Pay: $17\.60\-$18\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Discounted or free food

Language:

* English (preferred)

Work Location: In person
